scope.role: Native implementation of frozen shared contract only; includes theme/models/services/fixtures/tests/project asset integration. No new shared semantics without barrier.

task:
# Target
Platform iOS: platform-specific implementation of frozen shared both-platform contract; WebV1 provides web counterpart without shared semantic change. Own apps/ios/Boarded/ only in assigned native worktree. Pair with named active designer V1Designer for every UI/interaction choice. Respect existing SwiftUI iOS18+, app/model/repository/offline-log architecture and bundled font. No web/SQL/Paper edits.
# Change
Implement all five real destinations (replace and prune obsolete Meetups UI/models/service/callers) and full contract APIs/Codable models. Feed must closely reproduce approved E6-0 populated target with actual production relationship, grade/route facts, author profile, heart kudos/comments/save/share and notification deep links; no fabricated fields/following. Expose full featured route inspection -> prefilled Log -> attempts including outcomes, conditions/notes -> finish session -> image result composition/publication via existing actual sync/storage/post machinery. Explore searchable routes/crags/gyms/boards/climbers, route details and follow/unfollow, saved state, and real creation of venue/route when needed (manual private logger remains supported). Activity real like/comment/follow/crew-send inbox with unread/read states and correct navigation. Profile private progress/bests/sessions/stats/saved routes; public climber pages show only authorized/public data and follow actions. Five nav controls all function; Log primary bottom reachable; authentication/error/loading/empty states honest and actionable. Add theme Indigo agency, green sent/red failures, all font/accessibility/dynamic-width constraints. No fake repositories in production. Migrate route_id and session context everywhere. Extend existing --boarded-ui-fixture and fixture repositories with exact approved deterministic Maya/Alex/Jordan Feed plus useful real stateful fixture actions for full journey; new hero asset under owned catalog from approved cloud/source crop. Keep old genuine log/session/profile behavioral tests; delete tests that only pin incidental wording instead of re-pinning. Add regression cases only for uncertain meaningful edges. Existing UI-test capture mechanism should expose deterministic Feed plus other changed states at compact+regular/large text without inventing production test flags.
# Acceptance
Complete native app code/assets/project integration, local owned commit, no dead destinations or data stubs. Send exact coverage, changed paths/base/head and narrow build/UITest/manual capture instructions and accessible identifiers/scenarios. Do not run build/simulator/tests/lint/formatters during concurrent authoring. Main will build/run once at dependency join with DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer, iOS26.3 runtime preserving deployment18+. V1Designer + independent rendered vision approval required after actual captures.
